{{Quote|Enjoy a giant Neuvian sundae made the old-fashioned way with two generous scoops of denta bean ice cream and your choice of Trammistan chocolate or zoochberry topping. Served with atomically aerated cream and a zherry on top.|Dex's Diner menu, on its double-scoop sundae|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Denta bean ice cream''' was a flavor of [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with [[Denta bean/Legends|denta beans]], a type of crop grown throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name=""> The [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] served denta bean ice cream a [[Cerean cone]]  and as part of the [[Neuvian sundae]] and the [[Tibanna split]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|deserts]] served at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] also offered a scoop of denta bean ice cream with its [[zoochberry cobbler]], [[wasaka berry pie]], and [[all-Almakian apple pie]] for an extra charge.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denta bean ice cream was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
